description: User pastes an address / contact text (WhatsApp message, visiting card, email signature). AI splits it into the delivery address parts and buyer contact fields. Nothing is saved automatically.
address_json_note: Order.deliveryAddress is a Json column. Suggestions come back as flat keys 'deliveryAddress.<part>'; assemble your JSON from them (rename keys to your existing shape).

fields.label: Pincode
fields.note: Only if written in the text

fields.label: Buyer phone (10-digit Indian mobile)
fields.note: Only if written in the text

fields.label: Buyer email
fields.note: Only if written in the text

fields.label: Buyer GSTIN
fields.note: Format and checksum are verified in code; must be written in the text

fields.label: Supplier GSTIN
fields.reason: Comes from the supplier's verified profile

fields.label: Amounts, tax, CGST/SGST/IGST, total
fields.reason: Calculated by deterministic code, never by AI
